title: RootCauseAnalysis
description: The only shape the diagnostician is allowed to emit. Enforced at decode time with constrained generation, then re-validated before the human gate.

cause_class.description: Must be a member of the closed cause vocabulary in router/action_policy.yaml

confidence.description: Calibration target, not a statistical confidence interval. Used only for gate thresholds.

evidence.description: Each item must cite a retrieved artifact. An RCA with no citation is rejected as unsupported.

source_ref.description: promql query, trace id, log selector, or runbook doc id
